cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(hypergolic_mesh_tls LANGUAGES C)
set(ENABLE_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_SHARED_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_STATIC_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config/mesh_tls_config.h" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(TF_PSA_CRYPTO_CONFIG_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config/mesh_crypto_config.h" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(mbedtls-4.2.0 upstream)
add_library(hypergolic_mesh_tls STATIC ../shared/hypergolic_mesh_tls.c ../shared/hypergolic_mesh_frame.c ../shared/hypergolic_mesh_pairing.c)
target_include_directories(hypergolic_mesh_tls PUBLIC ../shared)
target_link_libraries(hypergolic_mesh_tls PUBLIC mbedtls mbedx509 tfpsacrypto)
set_target_properties(hypergolic_mesh_tls PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
  target_compile_options(hypergolic_mesh_tls PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wpedantic)
endif()
if(HYPERGOLIC_MESH_TLS_TESTS)
  add_executable(mesh_tls_proof ../../../tests/native/mesh-tls/proof.c)
  target_include_directories(mesh_tls_proof PRIVATE ../shared)
  target_link_libraries(mesh_tls_proof PRIVATE mbedtls mbedx509 tfpsacrypto)
  set_target_properties(mesh_tls_proof PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
endif()
